replies.author: Xuph
replies.body:
UPDATE:

- Moved arrow spawner location a bit backwards and added a wall due to arrow spawner being directly in-front of gapple spawner, making the gapple spawner really hard to control and stale.

http://imgur.com/a/dqxTI

- Gapple Spawner: 1 gapple every 4 seconds
- Arrow Spawner: 1 arrow every 2 seconds
